item.title: Parasakthi Box Office Collections: Sivakarthikeyan, Sudha Kongara's film records BIG drop on 2nd Sunday, cume crosses Rs 55 cr in 9 days
item.description: Sivakarthikeyan's latest outing, Parasakthi recorded a big drop on its second Sunday after gaining a good traction on Pongal.
